Our Story
Built by Doctors,
for Doctors

MedMasters was born out of frustration. We watched talented doctors and medical students fail not because they lacked knowledge — but because they lacked the right tools to prepare.

Local MCQ banks were outdated. International platforms were expensive and irrelevant to many exams — particularly the local ones. So we built something better: a platform that's premium, precise, and built specifically for JCAT and FCPS aspirants. We also expanded to USMLE, PLAB, and AMC by bringing experienced doctors — who have already aced these exams — onto our Medical Editors Board.

Today, 27,000+ students trust MedMasters to prepare them for the most important exams of their medical careers. Every MCQ is vetted, every explanation is detailed, and every topic maps directly to the official syllabus.

MedGolden for Radiology 🏅
FCPS Part 1 Radiology Past Papers · 6,290 MCQs

FCPS Part 1 Diagnostic Radiology Past Papers

MedGolden for Radiology is a recall-based archive of FCPS Part 1 Diagnostic Radiology past papers: 6,290 MCQs compiled through candidate recalls spanning multiple years and sittings. An indispensable resource for FCPS Part 1 Radiology candidates and equally high-yield for JCAT MS Diagnostic Radiology candidates. The most sought-after radiology recall collection in Pakistan, built and curated by doctors at MedMasters.

📝 Note: As not all MCQs can always be recalled with full accuracy, MedMasters has included only those MCQs that were genuinely asked and recalled by candidates who appeared in the examination.
6,290Total MCQs
24+Batches
2026Latest Update
FCPS+JCATDual Use

Past Papers — All Batches

Who is MedGolden for Radiology for?

MedGolden for Radiology is built for FCPS Part 1 Diagnostic Radiology candidates preparing for the CPSP examination, and is included as an extra resource for JCAT MS Diagnostic Radiology candidates because the two syllabi overlap substantially. Each MCQ is a genuine recall from a real FCPS Part 1 Radiology past paper sitting.

MedGolden for Radiology is the Radiology equivalent of MedPink Files — the most popular recall-based past paper resource for Gynae & Obs. Just as MedPink transformed Gynae preparation, MedGolden is set to become the panacea for securing induction into FCPS Part 1 Diagnostic Radiology.

FCPS Part 1 Gynae & Obs Past Papers — 2014 to 2025

MedPink Files is a year-wise, fully solved archive of FCPS Part 1 Gynaecology & Obstetrics past papers from February 2014 to 2025 — 6,050 MCQs with detailed explanations, organised into 5 chronological batches. Past Papers — Year-wise Batches

Who is MedPink Files for?

MedPink Files is built for FCPS Part 1 Gynae & Obs candidates preparing for the CPSP examination, and is included as an extra resource for JCAT Gynae & Obstetrics candidates because the two syllabi overlap substantially. Each MCQ in MedPink Files is taken from a real FCPS Part 1 Obs & Gyne past paper and comes with a structured explanation referenced to standard textbooks (Williams Obstetrics, Obstetrics by Ten Teachers, Gynaecology by Ten Teachers, Shaw's Textbook of Gynaecology, Katzung).

How MedPink Files is organised

The 6,050 past paper MCQs are split into 5 year-wise batches so you can revise chronologically — newest sittings first, or work backwards through earlier papers. Each batch covers a defined window of FCPS Part 1 Obs & Gyne sittings:

  • MedPink 18-19 — FCPS Part 1 Gynae & Obs papers from 2024 to 2025 · 300 MCQs
  • MedPink 14-17 — FCPS Part 1 Gynae & Obs papers from 2022 to 2023 · 1,975 MCQs
  • MedPink 9-13 — FCPS Part 1 Gynae & Obs papers from September 2019 to December 2021 · 1,515 MCQs
  • MedPink 5-8 — FCPS Part 1 Gynae & Obs papers from September 2017 to April 2019 · 830 MCQs
  • MedPink 1-4 — FCPS Part 1 Gynae & Obs papers from February 2014 to July 2017 · 1,430 MCQs

Frequently asked questions

How many MCQs are in MedPink Files?

MedPink Files contains 6,050 fully solved FCPS Part 1 Gynaecology & Obstetrics past paper MCQs from February 2014 to 2025, split into 5 year-wise batches with detailed explanations.

Are MedPink Files useful for JCAT Gynae & Obstetrics candidates?

Yes. The FCPS Part 1 Obs & Gyne syllabus overlaps significantly with the JCAT Gynae & Obs syllabus, so JCAT Gynae & Obs subscribers on MedMasters get MedPink Files included alongside Paper 1 and Paper 2.

Where do these papers come from?

Each MCQ is sourced from a real FCPS Part 1 Obs & Gyne past paper sitting between February 2014 and 2025, then carefully curated and explained by doctors on the MedMasters team.

How is MedPink Files different from "Pink Files"?

MedPink Files is an independently curated FCPS Part 1 Gynae & Obs past paper bank built by MedMasters. The format was inspired by the long-established style of pink past paper compilations widely used by Pakistani postgraduate medical candidates, but the content, explanations, and platform are entirely MedMasters' own work.

Welcome Back!
MedMasters is Pakistan's most comprehensive online preparation platform for the NTS Medical Officer (MO) and Women Medical Officer (WMO) written exam. Candidates preparing for NTS MO and NTS WMO positions in Punjab, Sindh, KPK, and Balochistan health departments can practice with 100,000+ past paper MCQs covering all exam subjects including Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics and Gynecology, Pediatrics, Pharmacology, Physiology, Anatomy, Pathology, ENT, Ophthalmology, Psychiatry, Community Medicine, Verbal Reasoning, and Analytical Reasoning. MedMasters offers 10 full-length 100-MCQ timed mock exams for NTS MO and WMO based on real past papers, with subject-wise performance analytics and detailed answer explanations. The platform is also used by candidates preparing for JCAT, FCPS Part 1, USMLE Step 1, and PLAB. MedMasters is trusted by over 27,000 doctors and medical students across Pakistan. Visit medmasters.academy to start your NTS Medical Officer or Women Medical Officer exam preparation today.
